repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-locus
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin for the Locus call and meeting state service. It registers webex.internal.locus, wraps the Locus REST operations (create, join, alert, decline, leave, get, list, sync, media update, DTMF, and floor grant) and the Janus call-history query, compares Locus sequence objects to decide whether an incoming Locus DTO replaces, is ignored, or requires a fetch, merges Locus delta DTOs into a caller-held working copy, and exports the list of Locus event names.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not change compareSequence without rerunning both JSON fixtures.
negative_guidance.why: The 134 fixture cases are the only executable definition of the Locus sequencing algorithm in this package.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not pass a delta DTO without a participants array to merge.
negative_guidance.why: merge reads incoming.participants.length when participants is absent and throws a TypeError.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not pass localSdp to updateMedia.
negative_guidance.why: updateMedia destructures sdp, although its JSDoc names options.localSdp; a localSdp key is ignored.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the method list.
negative_guidance.why: Its usage block shows a placeholder property. See docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: The developer confirmed no coverage gate applies; jest-config-legacy sets collectCoverage false.
